svg.title: Who sees what
svg.desc: Nobody can see which deposit paid for a trade, your keys or your 12 words; timing and amount can hint. Anyone watching the chains sees deposits in, standard payouts out and a new wallet buying. NEAR Intents sees each leg it carries. Our helper sees IP, time, quotes, proofs and orders it carries. The hosting sees IP, browser and files loaded, and what the helper sees at its machine. The app team sees what the helper sees if it looks inside the machine. None of them sees a key, and none sees which deposit a proof spends.
